import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int[] a = new int[6];
        while (sc.hasNextInt()) {
            int n = sc.nextInt();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[i] = sc.nextInt();
            }
            Arrays.sort(a, 0, n);
            System.out.println(a[n / 2]);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
